name: Garden colors
notes: The colors of the menu's garden plots (spr_plot): soil browns (the same as the garden bed's in pal_menu_field, for the little dug hole of a ripe item), leaf greens, the HP UP heart's reds and the POWER UP fist's skin and red cuff, all in one palette since a sprite has only one. Lit from the top-left like the rest of the game.
